lead: Cinematic sci-fi film still, gritty military, olive green and red tones.
notes: Mood-only mini images for AAL-Bunkerships.html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen AAL-Bunkerships-mini --model sdxl --max 999, then finish AAL-Bunkerships-mini --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's own opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.name: golden-age
images.prompt: A peaceful gleaming space colony city where people, friendly aliens and machines live together in a kind, abundant civilization, starships rising over green parks.

images.name: whos-out-there
images.prompt: Renegades, would-be dictators and plain thugs who have grabbed a star system for themselves and run it on piracy, vandalism and plunder.

images.name: moment-to-moment
images.prompt: Side-view combat where everything is a physical object. You lead from the front with one soldier while the others hold, follow or flank.

images.name: region
images.prompt: A war room table with a glowing square grid map of a planet's surface, unit markers and fog, officers leaning over it.

images.name: hangar
images.prompt: Your fleet lives in an enormous hangar, built from your own blueprints. You name your ships and keep a journal of their operations.

images.name: evening
images.prompt: Prepare in the hangar, where time stands still, so you can tinker for as long as you like.

images.name: command-core
images.prompt: Every faction's forces in a region run through a Command Core: a hardy metal ball, the king piece of the board.

images.name: brands
images.prompt: Complete military kits, each with its own style, covering soldiers, weapons, vehicles, turrets, ship modules and gear.

images.name: fog
images.prompt: The map starts dark. Scouts, flares, towers and spy satellites push back the fog.

images.name: restore
images.prompt: When the land is spent, you restore it to life and move your equipment to the next site.
